opening.argument: The presentation expressly sets out to explain “in simple language how to DefiGenex ecosystem works” and describes participation in a liquidity system, decentralized-exchange activity, and yield distribution. Its educational framing is reinforced by the description’s statement that it is for “educational and informational purposes only” and does not constitute financial advice. The presentation does show dollar-denominated packages, daily ROI figures, an “INVEST NOW” prompt, and referral or commission options, but those features alone do not establish deception. The available evidence documents no payment, return, verified liquidity relationship, or loss, and one stated return percentage lacks specified conditions. The record therefore supports an informational DeFiGeneX/Web3 presentation describing platform participation and a future roadmap, without overclaiming an outcome.
